{{Top|leg}}
The '''Skills implant''' was an upgraded version of the [[skills package]]. This device modified chemicals in the brain in order to enhance general problem solving and data processing abilities. It allowed for an increase in the performance of skill-related tasks, making it a valuable implant of its type.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 14 or higher.
